def transform(grid):
    """Extend diagonal runs of nonzero foreground colors through background."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max({v for row in grid for v in row},
                     key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    source = [row[:] for row in grid]

    for color in range(1, 10):
        if color == background:
            continue
        coords = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                  if source[r][c] == color}
        for dr, dc in ((1, -1), (1, 1)):
            for r, c in coords:
                # Process a maximal diagonal run only once.
                if (r - dr, c - dc) in coords:
                    continue
                run = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while (rr, cc) in coords:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                if len(run) < 2:
                    continue
                # Extend both ends of the run, stopping at any non-background cell.
                for sr, sc, step_r, step_c in (
                    (run[0][0] - dr, run[0][1] - dc, -dr, -dc),
                    (run[-1][0] + dr, run[-1][1] + dc, dr, dc),
                ):
                    rr, cc = sr, sc
                    while (0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w
                           and source[rr][cc] == background):
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr += step_r
                        cc += step_c
    return out
